I have tried dozens of mirrors, all either fogged up and were hard to clear, or the majority ended up broke eventually.  This mirror is very light weight, which could initially make you question its quality, but that is not the case. The reviewer who complained about the mirror being dirty may not have realized there was a plastic coating that you're supposed to peel off to reveal the shiny and clean mirror underneath. Extremely easy too install (just hang it on the shower head or any other place you'd like). Cleaning is easy since you can "uninstall" it so easily. I'm not sure if it has any anti-fog technology built in, but I didn't notice it being an annoying problem when I was using it. It isn't made of glass so it won't

reviews.t: Ended up becoming cloudy, it broke, then cut my foot.
reviews.x: She was pretty nice while it lasted, maybe a year at most, then it eventually became cloudy and wasn't as reflective as I would have liked or as it originally was.  I dropped it once and it broke off the hook end leaving a sharp corner. I wasn't too concerned as it wasn't glass and since I never had a great place to hook it in our shower. So I just kept leaning it against the wall of a built-in shelf in the shower until one day it fell from there, right onto my foot, leaving me with a nice deep

This is probably the best bang-for-buck purchase I ever made on Amazon. It's durable, works as expected and makes shaving waaaay more pleasurable.  Pro tip: About every 4 months I treat it with a Rain-X typeproduct (Note: I don't think you can use Rain-X on plastic, so make sure yours will not damage it) and that significantly increases my shaving pleasure. It makes the water bead off the mirror surface while showering. It also slows the buildup of minerals from the water on the mirror surface.

the mirror is not fog-free. it collects fog very easily but then just a splash of water and it clears up of course. it is very light.  update 9/26/2016: been over 6 years since i got this. dropped countless times and it prevails with not a single scratch, let alone shatter. amazing product.

As someone who travels 90% of the time, and shaves their head, this product is great.  I've had to resort to shaving in front of hotel mirrors instead of using my "home" routine of shaving in the shower.  This product fixed that.  It fits in my luggage nicely.  Very durable, so far hasn't broken or scratch.  I just toss it in with my shirts and slacks - no sharp edges on the mirror, so it hasn't damaged my clothes.  It hangs on all the shower heads I've used so far.  You can slide the "hook" dow

saves hours of time over the year...  man I enjoy shaving in the shower...  time saver, so much better than over the sink, refreshing, no need to carry shaving cream...  and this baby just wet it down, hold it with one hand and shave with the other...  rinse and ready to roll!!

reviews.t: This is great except for the mirror part.
reviews.x: I love how it hangs in the shower and holds my razor but as a mirror it leaves a lot to be desired.  This thing fogs up constantly.  I either have to keep wiping it off or showering it off to get rid of the fog.  Spend your money elsewhere.

reviews.t: Shower/Travel Safety Mirror is not fog free, but is everything else!
reviews.x: I am happy with this shower/travel mirror.  It does the job well without any worries of breaking/cracking.  The built in hanger works well over my shower head and when not in use, also hangs nicely on our shower rod tucked out of the way.  Light weight, nice size, compact enough to pack in a suitcase if needed, or for kids to use, but big enough for adult use as well.  It is not fog free, but just stick it under the water and you'll have fog free use for a bit.  BE SURE TO PEEL THE PROTECTIVE FI

I bought this months ago, have used it on 4 different vacations/trips.  It is fog free.  It does not scratch (so far) or break.  It hangs nicely on hook, or shower head or door knob.  One of my pet peeves in hotel rooms are the mirrors.  Sometimes they are placed too far back on counter, sometimes too high up (am not tall), sometimes just very oddly placed.  And..... I like to see the back of my hair when I am dressing up for a night out, and this mirror fits the bill.  I can place it where I wa

I bought this item back in January and it's been working well 10 months later. I initially bought this because of the hook - I lived in an apartment where suction cups wouldn't stick well on the bathtub walls - and I was looking for something fairly cheap. Provided that you follow the instructions (run hot water through the front and back of the mirror for 3 seconds) then it works just fine. reviews.t: What You See is NOT What You Get
reviews.x: Just received this item.  I won't be using it in the shower -- just wanted to hang it when needed then put away, in my RV.  So, I can't attest at this time to how resistant it might be to fog or shattering.  However, when I received was not exactly as pictured.  There is 1/4 inch deep and 3/4 inch long notch cut out along the right lower edge as it hangs.  I don't see this as a problem or that it interferes with the function.  It's just I wonder why the photo and what I received was not identica

reviews.t: A time saver and almost fog free
reviews.x: Anyone who likes to shower and then shave knows that it adds time to your routine. If you live in cold places where the mirror defogs during winter, the wait is even longer.  How about a mirror that allows you to shave and shower at the same time? And is also practically fog free. I found this mirror and it is practically a life saver, I save so much time as I shave while taking a shower. This mirror is extremely light, hangs around the shower head and almost hard to break. It does have edges wh

I bought this to shave in the shower both at home and in the gym, and it works well for both.  There is no such thing as "truly fog-free," as fog is the condensation of the humid air/water in the shower on the colder mirror surface.  However, it's easy to defog in a second -- put a little soap on it and wash it off, and the mirror stays fog-free for 5-10 minutes, which is perfect for my shave. reviews.t: Great size, light weight, not breakable, and easy to hold.
reviews.x: I thought it might be too big, but it is perfect for shaving in the show.  Just run water on it to clear fog.  Weighs almost nothing, and has a variety of notches to help hang it, or hold it.  I really like not having glass in the shower.  Update 7/12/2014:  I've dropped this many times and not a scratch on it.  Also I am on a well and it picked up some of the white calcium we have out here, and it wiped clean.  If I could give it 6 stars I would.  One minor nit is that  new shower head angles s

reviews.t: Good size, yet lightweight and handy
reviews.x: This is a simple, plastic mirror that hooks just fine onto our soap/shampoo rack. NOTE: There is an easy-to-remove protective film covering the mirror -- some may mistaken it for poor mirror quality. Not so.  Since it's plastic, I don't have to worry about it shattering should it ever be dropped. I also like that it's fairly large so you definitely see more of your reflection.  No fogging issues yet. But no matter. I'd just resort to the old swim goggle trick: a little bit of spit always does th

I bought this to hang over the sink because my 2-year-old couldn't see to brush her teeth.  It works well for that, and is safe for her to play with elsewhere.  It's seen some rough handling and has a few tiny scratches on it, that's all.  It's a perfect mirror, no warping.  Edit: I've had this for over a year now and it's still great. I'm going to buy another as a baby shower gift for the mom who already has everything. Most mirrors they sell for little kids are small and crappy, this one is bi

I needed to replace my more expensive shower mirror that had water running across the face to keep from fogging, because it finally cracked.  Although skeptical, this mirror works even better for my needs.  Yes it does fog up, but since you are holding it with one hand while shaving with the other, it is simple to quickly rinse it off.  Holding the mirror allows for a better view of the area being shaved.  It hangs simply on the shower head when not in use, and includes a convenient slot to hold

reviews.t: Excellent fog free mirror for showers without exposed tile.
reviews.x: You can hang this mirror from the shower curtain hooks, the shower head itself or wherever you fancy. It can be used in a tiled shower as well, just procure a suction cup hook to hang it from. Nearly indestructible plastic & great mirror in general. To keep it truly fog free (and not impossibly dirty) I use a spray on, no scrub shower cleanser on it every time I shower. It keeps it in like new condition.

reviews.t: Perfect mirror for shaving in the shower
reviews.x: I've been using this mirror for over 4 months now, and it has saved me so much time and aggravation when shaving. Defogging is fast and easy: just run it under the water you're already standing in. The shower head hook and hole for hanging a razor are both really convenient too. Maybe when I drop it on my foot I'll have something to complain about, but it won't be the product's fault!

Once you get used to shaving in the shower, guys, you will never want to shave any other way.  This little mirror works great!  It won't break (certainly not something you would want to have happen in a SHOWER!) and it defogs simply by putting it under the warm water of the shower.  You'll love it.  In fact, I'm going to go order another one right now as a back up and for traveling.

reviews.t: Fogs within seconds of turning on the shower.
reviews.x: This is definitely not a fog-free mirror.  It fogs instantly when my husband gets in the shower to use it.  He has to take a towel into the shower to wipe the mirror off, and then he has to shave with the shower doors open to prevent the mirror from re-fogging.  My husband likes the size of this mirror, but it is clearly not an anti-fog or fog-free mirror.  Would not recommend.

This thing is great.  It's light weight and easy to hang anywhere.  I simply screwed in a hook into the wall just above the shower stall, hung the mirror and started using it that day.  It keeps the fog away and if it gets mucked up at all with water drops, one simple swipe of my hand and I'm good to go.  For the price and ease of use, I give this mirror a five star rating.

reviews.t: LOL "fog free" - um, not so much.
reviews.x: Good price for a decent product.  Bonus points for being able to hang it on shower caddy.  "Fog free", though?  No.  This is not a fog-free mirror.  Maybe if it's not in the shower.  In the shower, however, it fogs up.  Is it better than not having a mirror in the shower?  I guess so.  I'll still use it.  Just gotta keep wiping it as you shave.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the mirror durable and shatter-resistant, noting it survives drops without breaking.
Reviewers frequently mention the mirror fogs up easily, though a splash of water clears it quickly.
Users praise its light weight and easy hanging on shower heads, hooks, or rods.
Several reviewers say it is great for travel and shaving in the shower, saving time.
A few reviewers report the mirror becoming cloudy or breaking over time, with one noting a sharp edge.
